arrival.speaker: venn_mother
arrival.text: Hello, Caelan. Come in quietly, would you? We’ve finally had a little sleep.

arrival.speaker: caelan
arrival.text: Of course. Serene asked me to bring these.

arrival.speaker: venn_mother
arrival.text: Thank you. I meant to get down to Serene’s house yesterday.

arrival.speaker: venn_mother
arrival.text: Better. A little food stayed down, and there hasn’t been so much restlessness.

arrival.speaker: venn_father
arrival.text: We both managed to sit down for a while.

arrival.speaker: venn_mother
arrival.text: Until you went out to the plot.

arrival.speaker: venn_father
arrival.text: I thought I could get the watering finished before it got warm.

arrival.speaker: venn_father
arrival.text: The irrigation gate’s jammed. There’s plenty of water in the brook, but hardly any getting through to the far end of our plot.

arrival.speaker: venn_father
arrival.text: Not all day. I’ve been carrying buckets over, but I can’t keep doing that.

arrival.speaker: caelan
arrival.text: I could look at the gate while I’m here.

arrival.speaker: venn_father
arrival.text: Would you? It’s just east of the cottage. Check the pin at the side, and the channel below the board.

arrival.speaker: venn_mother
arrival.text: The tools are in the box. Borrow what you need.

arrival.speaker: caelan
arrival.text: I’ll come back and tell you how I get on.

resolution.speaker: venn_father
resolution.text: It’s reaching the far end now. I saw it coming through.

resolution.speaker: caelan
resolution.text: The pin was caught at an angle. I set it straight and cleared what was under the board.

resolution.speaker: venn_father
resolution.text: Thank you. I’d have spent the rest of the morning hauling water.

resolution.speaker: venn_mother
resolution.text: Then you can spend some of it in here.

resolution.speaker: caelan
resolution.text: Does it catch like that often?

resolution.speaker: venn_father
resolution.text: Often enough that I keep thinking about a pump. They’ve got them in the capital that could do this without all the lifting.

resolution.speaker: venn_mother
resolution.text: We’d still have to buy it. And get it repaired when something went wrong.

resolution.speaker: venn_father
resolution.text: I know. I’m not ordering one. I’d just like to get the watering done without losing half a day to it.

resolution.speaker: caelan
resolution.text: Would you want Mira to look at the gate?

resolution.speaker: venn_father
resolution.text: If it catches again, I’ll ask her. For now, you’ve got it working.

resolution.speaker: venn_mother
resolution.text: Please tell Serene we’re grateful. And that this morning’s been better.

resolution.speaker: caelan
resolution.text: I will. Do you think you’ll make it to the festival?

resolution.speaker: venn_mother
resolution.text: We’re hoping to. We’ll have to see how tomorrow goes.

resolution.speaker: caelan
resolution.text: All right. I’ll let you have some quiet.

reminder.speaker: venn_father
reminder.text: The gate’s east of the cottage. Have a look at the pin and the channel underneath. The tools are there if you need them.

pin.speaker: caelan
pin.text: The pin’s wedged crooked. The water’s pressing the board against it.

channel.speaker: caelan
channel.text: There are twigs caught underneath as well. Even if I free the pin, I’ll need to clear those.

choice.speaker: caelan
choice.text: The mallet should help with the pin. Or I could try pushing the water back for a moment—just enough to take the pressure off.

after.speaker: venn_mother
after.text: It’s still running. Thank you again—and tell Serene we’ve had a better morning.

hands_full.speaker: caelan
hands_full.text: I should set Elira’s lantern down safely before I take anything else in hand.
